diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~118% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.376), which favours a weighted combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.9103 and seasonal strength 0.0428; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.376); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 7.578.
